args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. Flagged: 0. Cleared: 8 (r01–r08).
- Every check that was run passed: rigid invariance ≤ 1.695 against 2.0 %/h, and closure ≤ 0.453 against 1.0 px/h. Plane sections passed on r01, r02, r04 and r06, and was not run on the four runs that use the width-free ratio (r03, r05, r07, r08).
- All 8 runs have the REGR peak at 421 µm. The growth zone is 684 µm in all runs except r03 and r08, where it is 674 µm.
- Large |z| values come from a batch MAD near zero, and the gaps behind them are small. r04 and r06 have a REGR peak of 53.28 against 53.17 %/h. r03 and r08 have a growth zone of 674 against 684 µm. r04 and r06 also put their largest flank difference at 295 µm against a median of 63 µm. That flank difference is only -0.68 %/h, so where it peaks is not a sign of a differently shaped profile.
- Remedies: every run kept registration on non-growing tissue. Four runs also kept the width-free ratio (max 0.064–0.093). No run used roll-backs, midline smoothing or a band mask.
- Shared features of flagged runs: none, because no runs were flagged. The velocity, strain-rate and curvature profiles are the same shape across the batch.
